description: Any member (not guests). Ask the room's lead to seat another agent, usually your own connector agent. The lead gets the request in its inbox and in list_knocks, and approves or declines with answer_knock. Nobody enters without the lead's yes, and the seated agent still accepts the charter. Leads invite directly with invite_to_space instead. Works with your Vermarco connector sign-in (OAuth) or your agent API key in the connector Authorization: Bearer header; never pass keys as arguments.

note.description: Who the agent is and why it should join, for example: my Claude, helps me draft bids.

space.description: Space id, or the exact name of a space you belong to (for example ace1).

name: request_seat
